subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept this default-off Feishu `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for proactive per-target outbound pacing once the branch is rebased and real proof is supplied?
rationale: Source inspection supports the Feishu-local pacing shape, but a new operator-facing config key and the acceptable proof bar for live delivery timing require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
options.body: Proceed with this PR or a refreshed equivalent after real Feishu proof and conflict resolution show same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.

options.title: Keep Only Reactive Retry
options.body: Reject the new config surface and document that OpenClaw relies on existing Feishu retry/backoff after rate-limit responses.

options.title: Defer To Broad Rate-Limit Work
options.body: Keep this Feishu-specific PR paused and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13615 own any cross-provider queueing or rate-limit policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR or a refreshed equivalent after real Feishu proof and conflict resolution show same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names this handle as the community-maintained owner candidate for Feishu-owned channel behavior.
